question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**surprise**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how society is obsessed with numbers.
 
• The word should indicate that it is expected or understandable why numbers are used in this context.
 
• "**Surprise**" fits well as it denotes something that is not unexpected, aligning with the context.
 
• Other options ("**resolution**", "**vibrance**", "**persistence**") do not fit the context of explaining that the use of numbers is predictable.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *We’re a society fixated on numbers. So, it’s no (1).* *surprise__* *we use measurements and equations to score our weight. The most (2).* **__________***is BMI, a measure of our body weight to height ratio. BMI (3).* **__________***bodies as underweight, normal or healthy weight, overweight or obese and can be a useful tool for weight and health (4).* **__________***. But it shouldn’t be used as the single (5).* **_________***of what it means to be a healthy weight when we set our weight loss goals.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Resolution (संकल्प): "Resolution" means a firm decision to do or not to do something, which does not fit the context.
 
• Vibrance (ऊर्जा): "Vibrance" means full of energy and life, which does not fit the context.
 
• Persistence (सथिरता): "Persistence" means firm or obstinate continuance in a course of action in spite of difficulty, which does not fit the context.
